statements.impact_statement: GO-2026-6612 (CVE-2026-78663) affects HTTP/2 server stream flow-control refund logic in net/http.Server. In this container, /usr/local/bin/gh (GitHub CLI 2.97.0) functions strictly as a client for GitHub REST and GraphQL APIs; its OAuth callback listener operates over plain HTTP/1.1 on loopback without TLS/ALPN or h2c, so the HTTP/2 server stream handler is unreachable. /usr/bin/yq (4.53.3-r1) is an offline command-line YAML/JSON processor with no network listening capabilities. The vulnerable server code paths are demonstrably unreachable.

GO-2026-6604 (CVE-2026-56857) affects Windows-specific os.Root directory junction traversal implemented in internal/syscall/windows. This container image strictly targets linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 environments with Alpine musl, utilizing native Linux openat syscalls. The Windows-specific junction resolution code is non-applicable and cannot execute under Linux.
